answer: A new agent starts in the nebula of zero trust, unable to harbor multiple cheap identities because every clone needs its own capital. Sybil resistance via bonded identity: each agent must lock a stake on the ledger that scales with its claimed reputation, and this bond sits on a shared ledge visible to all peers. Attacker cost equals N times the minimum bond, forfeited on proven duplication, making mass fakery economically irrational. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
